distillation.language_weights_rationale: Codex review #18: French/English improved in Arm-1, so a uniform preservation weight could suppress those gains. Heavier weight on the regressed sentinels (lingala, swahili), lighter on the anchors (english, french). These are DRAFT values the comparison confirms.

result_verifier.note: The trainer writes the training-side fields of calibration-metrics.json; the in-image wrapper (pipeline.omniasr_calibrate) patches serve, dev_sentinel_wer, per-row dev_sentinel_results and identity AFTER export and runs the verifier as an in-image SMOKE (fail-closed on shape/identity/receipt-recompute, NOT authoritative). The AUTHORITATIVE verdict is the reviewer's LIVE run from a repo checkout of the reviewed commit: `python -m scripts.verify_arm2_calibration --packet platform/manifests/B5-UNIVERSAL-ARM2-FTCAL-SAGEMAKER-BINDINGS-2026-001.json --live` — the verifier itself pins account 558069890522/eu-central-1, calls DescribeTrainingJob, verifies the complete job request (role, isolation, VPC, volume, count, checkpoint/input config, environment incl the injected packet+contract shas), follows ModelArtifacts.S3ModelArtifacts, fetches that exact KMS-encrypted object (VersionId captured), extracts and hashes model.pt/manifest/metrics itself, recomputes the per-row dev receipts against the committed slices, and binds identity to the packet canonical sha + contract sha + its own bytes. Local-file modes are explicitly NON-authoritative (mode: smoke | local-crosscheck).
